triage.note: Live-caught while re-measuring content-bottom alignment after amendment (7)'s `.pane-meta` overlay fix landed: jpm-2024 item 1A (136,416 chars, shown to 40,000) still measured pre.text bottom 1161 vs #src-frame bottom 1185 at 1920x1080 — a 24px gap. Cause: the truncated-text notice ('Showing the first N of M characters') was still its own in-flow <div> sibling right after pre.text, the exact defect class `.pane-meta` had just been fixed for, reintroduced through a second element neither ui-pane-meta-amendment nor ui-equal-pane-heights could see (both are scoped to CSS selectors, not the JS render template's element order). Fixed by folding the notice into `.pane-meta`'s own `<dl>` as a `shown` row — already out of flow. Watched red against the pre-fix template (it.truncated referenced before the .pane-meta block), green once it moved inside.

provenance: S5 round 4, created 2026-08-22 immediately after finding the defect via browser re-measurement, before the fix, per hard rule 2.
